@@ -0,0 +1,390 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env node
+// collect.mjs — read real git history and write story.json.
+//
+// Usage:
+//   node collect.mjs --repo <path> [--from tag|sha|date] [--to <ref>]
+//                    [--max-commits N] [--include-contributors]
+//                    [--out <file>]
+//
+// Default range: last tag -> HEAD; if the repo has no tags, last 30
+// days to HEAD; if the repo is younger than that, the entire history.
